terms.title: B2: Programming Fundamentals & Python Constructs

terms.title: B1: Computational Thinking & B3: Single-Class OOP
terms.description: Problem decomposition, abstraction, flowchart logic, class structure, constructors, instance variables, encapsulation, and unit testing.

terms.title: B4: ADTs (HL Only) & A3: Relational Databases
terms.description: Linked lists, binary search trees (BSTs), sets, relational database modeling, ERDs, 1NF–3NF normalization, and multi-table SQL queries.

terms.title: Year 12 Timed Assessments & IA Prototype Drafting
terms.description: End-of-Year exams; client consultation, Criterion A planning, Criterion B system architecture & record of tasks, and first working prototype.

terms.title: A1: Computer Fundamentals & A4: Machine Learning
terms.description: Von Neumann CPU architecture, GPU functions, cache memory, logic gates, truth tables, OS scheduling, and introductory machine learning algorithms.

terms.title: A4: ML Deep Dive, A2: Networks & Final IA Submission
terms.description: Deep learning architectures, hyperparameter tuning; packet switching, TCP/IP, network security; final submission of IA Criterion D & E with video demonstration.
terms.milestone: CRITICAL: Official IA Final Submission (Criterion A–E)

terms.title: Paper 3 Case Study Seminars & Full Mock Exams
terms.description: Intensive analysis of pre-seen Case Study ("The Perfect Chatbot"), full mock examinations under real timed conditions, and past paper mastery drills.

terms.title: Official IB External Diploma Examinations
